title: AppButton — replace Container+GestureDetector with FilledButton/OutlinedButton/FilledButton.tonalIcon/TextButton
objective: Replace the manual Container + BoxDecoration + GestureDetector click stack inside AppButton._buildButtonChild with the appropriate Material 3 button widget selected by AppButtonVariant, while keeping the public constructor signature byte-identical and preserving the design-system hover/press feedback wrappers.
description: Currently AppButton renders its visual block as a Container with BoxDecoration (background color, border, borderRadius) wrapped in a GestureDetector that owns the onTap callback. This duplicates Material's InkWell and forfeits splash/ripple, accessibility roles, and ripple-driven press feedback. The fix replaces that body with one of FilledButton / OutlinedButton / FilledButton.tonalIcon / TextButton, picked by AppButtonVariant. The existing _HoverOpacityWrapper and _PressScaleWrapper remain as the outer cosmetic layer (they are token-driven and still gated on MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf). The Material button's own onPressed (set to effectiveOnPressed) becomes the click target; the outer wrappers only drive opacity and scale, not callbacks.

anchors: lines 26-50 — AppButtonVariant + AppButtonSize enums (DO NOT EDIT, this is the public API surface)
lines 58-97 — constructor + public fields (DO NOT EDIT, signature must remain byte-identical)
lines 103-131 — size / padding / icon token maps (DO NOT EDIT, keep verbatim)
lines 137-181 — _backgroundColor / _foregroundColor / _borderColor / _borderWidth (refactor to a single _styleFor(context) returning ButtonStyle)
lines 187-227 — build() (keep the _HoverOpacityWrapper + _PressScaleWrapper composition; pass the Material button produced by _buildButtonChild into those wrappers)
lines 229-266 — _buildContent (DO NOT EDIT — this Row layout is the child of every variant)
lines 268-304 — _buildButtonChild (REWRITE — return Material button + style; delete the Container + GestureDetector + BoxDecoration)
lines 316-381 — _HoverOpacityWrapper + _PressScaleWrapper (DO NOT EDIT — they remain the cosmetic outer layer)

variant_to_widget_mapping.primary: FilledButton — backgroundColor: AppColors.cta, foregroundColor: Colors.white, shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: Radii.button)
variant_to_widget_mapping.secondary: OutlinedButton — backgroundColor: Colors.transparent, foregroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.primaryLight : AppColors.primary, side: BorderSide(color: same, width: 1.5), shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: Radii.button)
variant_to_widget_mapping.tertiary: FilledButton.tonalIcon — uses Theme's secondaryContainer/onSecondaryContainer by default; preserves the surface-fill semantics without hardcoding surfaceDark/surfaceLight
variant_to_widget_mapping.ghost: TextButton — backgroundColor: Colors.transparent, foregroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.primaryLight : AppColors.primary

size_to_style_mapping.sm: minimumSize: Size.fromHeight(36), padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: Spacing.space_2xs, vertical: Spacing.space_xs), iconSize: 16, labelStyle: AppTypography.buttonSmall
size_to_style_mapping.md: minimumSize: Size.fromHeight(44), padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: Spacing.space_xs, vertical: Spacing.space_sm), iconSize: 20, labelStyle: AppTypography.buttonMedium
size_to_style_mapping.lg: minimumSize: Size.fromHeight(52), padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: Spacing.space_sm, vertical: 20), iconSize: 24, labelStyle: AppTypography.buttonLarge

state_behavior.isLoading: When true, the Row passed as child contains a 20x20 CircularProgressIndicator (strokeWidth 2, valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(foreground)) in place of the label Text. The Material button's onPressed is still wired to effectiveOnPressed (so loading state does not disable the button — same as today).
state_behavior.isDisabled: When true, effectiveOnPressed is null (passed to Material's onPressed) AND the entire content Row is wrapped in Opacity(0.5). Preserve the existing effectiveOnPressed / effectiveOpacity logic verbatim.
state_behavior.isFullWidth: When true, wrap the Material button in SizedBox(width: double.infinity) so it fills the parent. minimumSize is still used so height stays correct.
state_behavior.disable_animations: Already respected by the preserved _HoverOpacityWrapper and _PressScaleWrapper — both check MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) before applying AnimatedOpacity / AnimatedScale. The Material button's own ripple respects the same MediaQuery automatically.

acceptance_criteria: _buildButtonChild (lines 268-304) no longer contains Container, BoxDecoration, Border.all, or GestureDetector — only a Material button (FilledButton / OutlinedButton / FilledButton.tonalIcon / TextButton) returned from a switch on AppButtonVariant
AppButtonVariant.primary renders FilledButton with style.backgroundColor = AppColors.cta and style.foregroundColor = Colors.white
AppButtonVariant.secondary renders OutlinedButton with style.side.width = 1.5 and side.color = AppColors.primary (light) or AppColors.primaryLight (dark)
AppButtonVariant.tertiary renders FilledButton.tonalIcon (or equivalent tonal fill) — no hardcoded surfaceDark / surfaceLight values in styleFrom
AppButtonVariant.ghost renders TextButton with style.foregroundColor = AppColors.primary (light) or AppColors.primaryLight (dark) and a transparent background
Every variant's style.shape uses RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: Radii.button) — no hardcoded BorderRadius.circular(...)
Every variant's style.minimumSize.height matches _heightTokens[size] (36 / 44 / 52) — no hardcoded double values for height
Every variant's style.padding uses Spacing tokens from app_spacing.dart — no hardcoded EdgeInsets numbers
Public class signature (constructor parameter list and all named-parameter defaults) is byte-identical to lines 58-69 — existing call sites compile without change
AppButtonVariant enum (lines 26-38) and AppButtonSize enum (lines 41-50) are unchanged
_buildContent (lines 229-266) is unchanged — it still returns the Opacity-wrapped Row with icon, optional progress, label, and trailingIcon
_HoverOpacityWrapper (lines 316-349) and _PressScaleWrapper (lines 351-381) are unchanged — they still gate on MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
isLoading=true still replaces the label with a 20x20 CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(foreground)) inside the row
isDisabled=true still sets onPressed=null AND applies Opacity(0.5) on the child
isFullWidth=true still wraps the Material button in SizedBox(width: double.infinity)
Animation tokens AppDurations.fast and AppCurves.standard are still used inside the preserved _PressScaleWrapper and _HoverOpacityWrapper — no hardcoded Duration or Curve
All existing call sites under lib/ that use AppButton(...) still compile unchanged (constructor signature preserved)
